DIAGNOSIS READY: Rotator Cuff Tendinopathy (likely Subacromial Impingement Syndrome).

I suspect inflammation of the rotator cuff tendons, specifically the supraspinatus, given the chronic nature of the pain and aggravation with overhead movements. I would like to confirm this by requesting an MRI of the left shoulder to visualize any tears or significant tendinosis. REQUEST IMAGES: Left Shoulder MRI.
